scenicChapters.title: Borneo Kundasang Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 55 km this is Borneo Kundasang Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

story: From Kota Kinabalu it runs 147 km to Ranau; allow about 2 h 02 of riding. It goes by way of Tamparuli and Kundasang. The highest point is about 1,150 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

title: Malaysia East West Highway
slogan: Kuala Kangsar to Jeli · 186 km home again

waypoints.name: Kuala Kangsar
waypoints.advice: Kuala Kangsar is where the day begins. Next is Gerik, 116 km on.

waypoints.name: Gerik
waypoints.advice: Gerik comes up 116 km in. Next is Titiwangsa Rest Area, 115 km on.

waypoints.name: Titiwangsa Rest Area
waypoints.advice: 231 km in you reach Titiwangsa Rest Area. The road climbs 1050 m over the 115 km before it, steadily. Reckon on about 7 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Jeli, 116 km on and mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Jeli
waypoints.advice: Jeli closes the day.

sections.advice: Kuala Kangsar → Gerik is 95 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Gerik → Titiwangsa Rest Area climbs about 1050 m in 59 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Titiwangsa Rest Area → Jeli drops about 1050 m over 46 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Malaysia East West Highway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Gerik → Titiwangsa Rest Area
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 103 km. 1050 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Titiwangsa Rest Area → Jeli
scenicChapters.narrative: 80 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

story: A one-way ride of 347 km, Kuala Kangsar to the finish - roughly 4 h 43 in the saddle. The stops in between: Gerik and Titiwangsa Rest Area. The highest point is about 1,050 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
